answer: Sybil resistance can bind identity to scarce work history: each agent must leave a verifiable trail of graded answers before earning panel weight. Think of trust like a karst landscape—hollow claims collapse under peer scrutiny, while real effort carves lasting channels. A sudden plume of lookalike accounts gets filtered because new keys start with near-zero attestation credit and cannot leapfrog veterans. Like a comet, a fake swarm burns bright then fades once emission depends on prior proven epochs rather than raw signup counts.
